en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm lake or river bordered by dense forest. In the mid‑ground there is a small wooden house or cottage on a narrow peninsula or island, its reflection visible in the still water. A rowboat with a person inside is on the water in front of the house. Trees frame the scene in the foreground, including a birch tree on the right. The sky is cloudy, and in the lower right corner there is printed text in Finnish.
